title: 第四章 入门 下
slug: 永恒剑主全本免费-永恒剑主最新章节列表
content_zh:
“看来你的剑术天赋确实不行，还是跟着我练毒砂掌吧，毒砂掌的来源，是传自北元年间，一位宫廷宦官....”
他这边稀里哗啦的说着一堆东西，但林新却是感觉眼前越来越模糊了，他用了十二万分注意力，才勉强让自己的剑法不歪得太严重。
眼前的模糊像是有什么东西重叠在了视野上，给人很不舒服的感觉。
那层重叠的东西随着时间的推移，逐渐越来越清晰起来。
“这....这是？？！”林新慢慢看清楚了这层影响他视力的东西是什么，顿时嘴巴微微张大，有些合不拢了。
在他眼前浮现的，赫然是他穿越前，还在和网友讨论的武侠游戏属性框！！
属性框呈淡红色，就在视野最下方排成一排。
杀伤，防御，闪避，体质。
四项最基本的属性都在，后面各自跟着一些小数字。
杀伤——2，防御——1，闪避——1，体质——1.
林新眨巴眨巴眼睛，发现属性后面还跟着一个红色符号，是一把小剑的样子，符号很小很小，要不是仔细看都看不清。
他把注意力集中在那上边，顿时看到那符号的瞬间，他心头自然而然的浮现出一行字。
‘红松剑法：入门。’
“专心点！”
又是一脚，伯云子身法如电，一下窜到场上狠狠给了林新一脚。
身上一痛，然后林新马上便看到自己的体质一栏后面出现个向下的箭头符号。
“这是表示体质正在缓慢下降吗？”
带着满脑子的疑惑，林新勉强集中精神练习完今天的任务，刺剑一千次，回到自己房内，他才仔细有时间好好琢磨这突然浮现出来的东西。
属性栏从出现后就一直稳定下来，没什么变化。
林新睡了一觉后，居然发现自己的体质后面那个箭头消失了，显然是恢复过来了。

心头一阵兴奋的他，睡了起来就开始在道馆周围乱窜。
“既然属性都能有用，那么其他系统能不能用？比如采药系统？”
他抱着这样的想法在周围草丛里转了一圈，属性栏没有丝毫变化，后面也没有多出什么异常符号。
一番试验下，除了属性栏和技能排列，这玩意儿就像是幻觉一样没什么变化。
比起游戏系统之类的解释，林新感觉这东西更像是一个软件，一个幻觉性质的软件，可以统计自己身体的状态，能够直观的看到自己的程度。
除了这个功能外，别无其他。
刚刚还欣喜不已的林新，整理出真实情况后，也有些灰心的回到房间。
一屁股坐在床上，他有些无奈的揉了揉脸。
“完全就是个大脑幻觉，游戏里面的其他功能完全没用，看来不是什么异能，果然世界上是不会有什么捷径啊....”
他看了眼边上的木剑，这是做来练习用的，随手提起来，他又开始重复白天的加练。以便熟悉这具身体原本就有的底子。
木剑暗灰色的剑身急速刺出去，没声音。
又刺。没声音。
又刺，还是没声音。
再刺，嗤。
一声极其细微的细响顿时出现。
林新忽然注意到，出现声音的这一剑刺出后，他的红松剑法符号后面居然也出现一个向上的箭头。
“这是......”他心头微微一动。视线落在这个符号上，顿时一段段信息从其中流出来。
‘红松剑法——入门。（进阶条件：掌握突刺，松阳针）’
“能够看到进阶条件？”林新心头微微有些火热，这样的话，遇到瓶颈的时候就能直接找准目标，不走冤枉路。
但更让他心生喜悦的是，刚刚偶然成功一次的突刺，居然像是技能一样留在他的视野内。

或者他闭上眼睛也能看到这个红色的技能符号，就像是一把剑往前突刺带起大量气流一样。
“这样看来，这能力还真像是一个安装在我大脑里面的软件，能够精确的把握我身体变化，也能精确的掌握身体记忆。”
林新心头简略分析了下。
心意在哪个技能上轻轻一点。
不由自主的，仿佛有什么力量操纵这他的身体，他提起木剑往前一刺。
轻微的破空声顿时响起。
“果然！”林新感觉到这一次和先前成功的那次感觉完全一样，使用的力气，角度，速度，都没什么区别。几乎就像是复制一般。
“完美记忆复制了成功的那一次突刺的身体记忆。真是....”林新也不知道该说什么好了，这能力已经属于对自我身体的入微控制了，不是超能力，却胜似超能力！

content_en:
"It seems that your swordsmanship talent is indeed not good. You should follow me to practice poisonous sand palm. The origin of poisonous sand palm is passed down from a palace eunuch in the Beiyuan period..."
He was talking nonsense, but Lin Xin felt that his vision was getting blurry. It took him 120,000 points of concentration to barely prevent his swordsmanship from being too serious.
The blur in front of my eyes seemed to have something overlapping my field of vision, which gave people a very uncomfortable feeling.
As time goes by, that layer of overlapping things gradually becomes clearer and clearer.
"This...is this??!" Lin Xin slowly saw clearly what was affecting his vision, and his mouth suddenly opened slightly and he couldn't close it.
What appeared in front of his eyes was the martial arts game attribute box that he was still discussing with netizens before he traveled through time! !
The attribute boxes are light red and are lined up in a row at the bottom of the field of view.
Killing, defense, dodge, constitution.
The four most basic attributes are all there, followed by some small numbers.
Killing - 2, defense - 1, dodge - 1, constitution - 1.
Lin Xin blinked and found that there was a red symbol following the attribute, which looked like a small sword. The symbol was so small that you couldn't see it clearly unless you looked carefully.
He focused his attention on it, and the moment he saw the symbol, a line of words naturally appeared in his mind.
‘Red Pine Swordsmanship: An Introduction. ’
"Pay attention!"
Another kick, Boyunzi's movement was like lightning, he rushed to the field and gave Lin Xin a hard kick.
There was a pain in his body, and then Lin Xin immediately saw a downward arrow symbol appearing behind his physical fitness column.
"Does this mean your physical fitness is slowly declining?"
With his mind full of doubts, Lin Xin reluctantly concentrated on practicing today's task, stabbing the sword a thousand times. After returning to his room, he had time to think carefully about what suddenly emerged.
The property bar has been stable since its appearance, with no changes.
After Lin Xin had a good sleep, he discovered that the arrow on the back of his body had disappeared. He had obviously recovered.
Feeling excited, he fell asleep and started running around the gym.
"Since attributes can be used, can other systems be used? For example, the herb collection system?"
With this idea in mind, he walked around in the surrounding grass. The attribute column did not change at all, and there were no more abnormal symbols behind it.
After some experiments, except for the attribute bar and skill arrangement, this thing is like an illusion and has no changes.
Compared with explanations such as a game system, Lin Xin feels that this thing is more like a software, a hallucinatory software that can count the status of his body and intuitively see his own level.
Apart from this feature, there is nothing else.
Lin Xin, who was overjoyed just now, returned to the room a little discouraged after sorting out the real situation.
Sitting down on the bed, he rubbed his face helplessly.
"It's just a brain hallucination. Other functions in the game are completely useless. It doesn't seem to be a superpower. Sure enough, there are no shortcuts in the world..."
He glanced at the wooden sword beside him. It was for practice. He picked it up casually and began to repeat the extra training during the day. In order to become familiar with the original foundation of this body.
The dark gray blade of the wooden sword stabbed out quickly without making any sound.
Stab again. No sound.
Stab again, still no sound.
Stab again, scoff.
An extremely subtle sound suddenly appeared.
Lin Xin suddenly noticed that after the sword thrust that made the sound, an upward arrow appeared behind his red pine sword technique symbol.
"This is..." His heart moved slightly. His eyes fell on this symbol, and pieces of information suddenly flowed out of it.
‘Red Pine Swordsmanship—Introduction. (Advanced conditions: Master the Thrust Thorn, Songyang Needle)’
"Be able to see advanced conditions? "Lin Xin felt a little hot in his heart. In this way, when he encounters a bottleneck, he can directly find the target and avoid taking the wrong path.
But what made him even more happy was that the thrust he had just succeeded in accidentally stayed in his field of vision like a skill.
Or if he closes his eyes, he can see this red skill symbol, like a sword thrusting forward and bringing up a lot of airflow.
"Looking at it this way, this ability is really like a software installed in my brain. It can accurately grasp the changes in my body and also accurately grasp the body's memory. "
Lin Xin briefly analyzed it in his mind.
Just tap on which skill your mind is focused on.
Involuntarily, as if some force was controlling his body, he picked up the wooden sword and stabbed forward.
A slight sound of breaking through the air suddenly sounded.
"Sure enough! "Lin Xin felt that this time it felt exactly the same as the previous successful one. There was no difference in the strength, angle, and speed used. It was almost like a copy.
“Perfect memory replicates the physical memory of a successful thrust. Really..." Lin Xin didn't know what to say. This ability is already a subtle control over his own body. It's not a super power, but it's better than a super power!
